value: This entry provides an overview and structured links to topics discussed in Masaki Kashiwara and Pierre Schapira's "Categories and Sheaves." The book systematically develops foundational category theory, including presheaves, representable functors, and universal constructions like limits and adjoints. It then progresses to modern category-theoretic homological algebra, focusing on derived and triangulated categories. Finally, it integrates these concepts with the theory of sheaves, particularly abelian sheaves, culminating in abelian sheaf cohomology and an outlook on stacks, serving as a comprehensive 1-categorical preparation for advanced studies in higher category theory.
